column1: # Transport destinations, for drawing where a transport goes. Derived from Shortest Path's transport lists
# (github.com/Skretzo/shortest-path, src/main/resources/transports/*.tsv at the Plugin Hub pin
# 50f30435f37d1d5c5e2af790925fa7aa70b7840d, BSD 2-Clause); see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Boarding tiles within
# 4 tiles of each other are merged into one spot. Records:
#   O <kind> x y plane                 a spot to board a network (every spot reaches every D of its kind)
#   D <kind> x y plane <name>          a network destination
#   P <kind> x y plane x y plane <name> a spot and one place it goes
